verify-spec.description: Verifies the acceptance criteria of a spec, fixes code issues and reports results
verify-spec.template:
Verify the acceptance criteria of the spec $ARGUMENTS.

Find the spec file in `specs/` (the user may have written the number like `01`, the slug like `home-feed`, or the full name `01-home-feed`). Read it, locate the acceptance criteria section, verify each criterion, fix any code issues you find, mark the checkboxes in the spec file, and report a summary at the end.
